hypothesis: Cross-reading Einstein's light/radiation development with JANUS process lineage may expose reusable certificate-composition patterns, especially exact elimination of internal variables and invariant live boundaries.
what_worked: Forward/reverse passes preserved a stable relative ordering of the leading bridge families under the frozen runner.
The audit independently surfaced exact-state/open-frontier and invariant-boundary patterns next to elimination/projection.
The runner retained the known representation/width blow-up obstruction instead of suppressing it.
A deterministic theorem-candidate operator cycle was extracted without hidden-solution or oracle leakage.
what_failed: No universal polynomial completeness proof for arbitrary CNF was produced.
No polynomial worst-case runtime proof was produced.
No polynomial representation-volume proof was produced.
No polynomial certificate-discovery proof was produced.
The scoring process itself did not meet its frozen numerical stabilization threshold for the leading bridges by pass 100.

post_result_lemmas.name: RANK_STABILITY_IS_NOT_SCORE_CONVERGENCE
post_result_lemmas.statement: A stable ranking across repeated passes is weaker than mathematical convergence of the scores; additive reinforcement kept the pass delta nonzero.

post_result_lemmas.name: MAXWELL_ANALOGY_EXPOSES_THE_RIGHT_OBLIGATION
post_result_lemmas.statement: Exact elimination is useful only if the eliminated information can be represented and discovered with bounded total resource volume; otherwise it recreates classical resolution/variable-elimination blow-up.

dead_paths_preserved: physics analogy -> complexity theorem without proof

open_frontier.name: UNIVERSAL_POLYNOMIAL_BOUNDARY_ELIMINATION_LEMMA
open_frontier.required: For every arbitrary CNF, prove a witness-independent deterministically discoverable exact certificate chain with polynomial cumulative discovery, representation, live-interface, canonicalization and verification volume.

next_authorized_step: Construct frozen adversarial CNF families with known elimination blow-up; compare ordinary resolution/Davis-Putnam to BCEG typed cross-language chains. Search for a provable boundary reduction mechanism rather than a heuristic ranking win.
